'''The Silent Year''' is the name scholars give to years 3–4 A.U. — an unnaturally empty window in the chronicles of [[the Banner-lands]].

It is not that nothing happened; it is that nothing was ''permitted'' to be recorded. Harvest rolls continue, tide tables continue, but the greater record simply thins to nothing and resumes as if mid-breath. A marginal scribe wrote beside the gap: ''"Why is year 3 empty?"'' — and that question, like its asker, was not answered.

Whatever the emptiness holds, it sits between the swearing of the [[Ash Oath]] and everything that followed. See [[The eleventh house]].
